blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Voice-based public services have evolved from manual switchboards to intelligent platforms to meet modern user needs. However, current systems remain constrained by rigid menu-driven interaction, fragmented vertical services, and limited extensibility. To address these issues, we present VISAGENT, an agent-based end-to-end voice interaction system for large-scale public services that integrates end-to-end speech interaction, hierarchical agent routing, a scalable voice-agent marketplace, and user memory support. The system replaces menu-driven workflows with natural speech and dynamically dispatches user requests to either a general conversational model or specialized domain agents via a two-level routing paradigm that achieves sub-second intent-to-agent selection over hundreds of agents. User memory informs preference-aware agent selection and supplies relevant preferences and context to selected agents, supporting personalized task execution and reducing the need for users to repeat previously provided information. A voice-agent registration mechanism converts task agents into conversational entities, enabling dynamic onboarding and ecosystem-level extensibility. We validate VISAGENT through a real-world deployment in China's 114 hotline across multiple service domains. Experimental results demonstrate low-latency full-duplex interaction, robust routing scalability, and competitive speech naturalness. More broadly, this work advocates a shift from isolated voice assistants toward agent-centric conversational infrastructures, providing a general blueprint for building extensible voice-agent systems in public services and beyond.
blocks.zh: 基于语音的公共服务已经由人工交换机演变为智能平台,以满足现代用户需要. 然而,目前的系统仍然受到僵硬的菜单驱动互动、分散的纵向服务以及有限的扩展性的限制。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了VISAGENT,一个基于代理的端到端语音互动系统,用于大型公共服务,该系统集端到端语音互动,分级代理路由,可伸缩语音代理市场,以及用户内存支持于一体. 该系统以自然语音取代菜单驱动的工作流程,并动态地向用户发送请求,通过双层路由范式,实现副秒意图到代理选择超过上百个代理. 用户内存向偏好-意识代理选择提供信息,并向所选代理提供相关偏好和上下文,支持个性化任务执行,并减少用户重复先前提供的信息的需求. 语音代理注册机制将任务代理转换为对话实体,使动态登机和生态系统层面的扩展成为可能。 我们通过在中国114条跨多个服务领域的热线进行现实部署,验证了VISAGENT。 实验结果表明,低纬度的全相通性相互作用、稳健的路由可伸缩性以及竞争性的语音自然性。 更广泛地说,这项工作主张从孤立的语音助理转向以代理为中心的谈话基础设施,为在公共服务部门内外建立可扩展的语音代理系统提供了总体蓝图。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Public-service hotlines provide a common entry point for users seeking information and assistance across everyday service domains. In settings such as China’s 114 hotline, users may need help with transportation, accommodation, healthcare, or local services without navigating separate applications. Telephone access is particularly useful when a spoken exchange is more convenient than a graphical interface. However, a single access number does not by itself unify the services behind it. Menu navigation, repeated transfers, and separate business systems can still require users to understand how services are organized before reaching the appropriate provider.
blocks.zh: 公共服务热线为寻求日常服务领域信息和援助的用户提供了一个共同的切入点。 在中国114热线等环境下,用户可能需要交通、住宿、医疗保健或本地服务方面的帮助,而无需单独申请。 当语音交换比图形界面更方便时,电话访问特别有用. 然而,单一的接入号码本身并不能统一其背后的服务。 菜单导航,重复传输,和单独的业务系统仍然可以要求用户在到达适当的提供者之前了解如何组织服务.

blocks.en: Speech interaction models and language-model-based agents provide building blocks for a different arrangement. A conversational model can handle open-ended requests, while a domain agent can expose the tools and business processes needed to complete a particular service. Combining them requires a framework that determines when conversation is sufficient, identifies the appropriate service domain, and selects an agent from the available providers. The framework must also carry information across the handoff so that the selected agent can continue the interaction rather than asking the user to start again.
blocks.zh: 语音交互模型和基于语言模型的代理为不同的安排提供了基石. 一个对话模式可以处理开放式请求,而一个域名代理可以曝光完成特定服务所需的工具和业务流程. 将它们组合起来需要一个框架,确定何时对话足够,确定适当的服务领域,并从现有的提供者中选择一个代理. 框架还必须将信息带过交接处,这样选定的代理可以继续交互,而不是要求用户重新开始.

blocks.en: VISAGENT combines end-to-end speech interaction with hierarchical routing to provide conversational access to public services. The speech interaction model supports low-latency, full-duplex spoken communication and directly handles general conversation and question answering. A lightweight first-level router directs requests either to this conversational model or to an appropriate service domain. For domain-specific requests, an LLM-based second-level selector identifies a suitable agent by matching the user’s requirements against the capabilities of agents registered within that domain. This organization connects general conversational assistance with specialized service access through a unified voice interface.
blocks.zh: VISAGENT将端对端的语音互动与分级的路由相结合,以提供对话获得公共服务的机会. 语音交互模式支持低纬度,全复式的语音交流,直接处理一般谈话和问答. 一个轻量级的一级路由器直接向这个对话模式或适当的服务域请求. 对于特定域的请求,一个基于LLM的二级选择器通过将用户的要求与在域内注册的代理的能力相匹配来确定合适的代理. 该组织通过统一的语音接口,将一般对话援助与专门的服务访问连接起来.

blocks.en: An extensible voice-agent marketplace and shared support services provide the basis for integrating heterogeneous agents into this architecture. Through a common registration mechanism, providers specify agent descriptions and callable interfaces, making their services available for discovery and invocation. Configurable voices enable agents with text-based business interfaces to deliver spoken responses suited to their roles and service contexts. A shared user memory service supplies relevant preferences and recent interaction context to both the second-level selector and the selected agent, supporting agent selection and subsequent task execution. Individual agents remain responsible for collecting task-specific information and carrying out their own business operations.
blocks.zh: 一个可扩展的语音代理市场和共享支助服务为将各种代理纳入这一架构奠定了基础。 通过一个共同的登记机制,供应商具体说明代理人说明和可调用接口,使其服务可供发现和援引。 可配置的声音使具有基于文本的业务界面的代理商能够提供适合其角色和服务背景的语音响应. 一个共享的用户内存服务向二级选择器和被选中的代理器提供相关的偏好和最近的互动上下文,支持代理器选择和随后的任务执行. 个体代理机构仍负责收集具体任务信息,开展本单位业务.

blocks.en: The deployment of VISAGENT in China’s 114 hotline illustrates a transition from menu-driven service access to intent-driven conversational interaction, as shown in Figure 1 . Traditional 114 services require callers to follow recorded prompts and navigate keypad menus before being connected to human operators. VISAGENT enables callers to express their requests directly in natural language, which are then routed to domain-specific agents for service execution or to the end-to-end conversational model for general inquiries. This transition preserves the telephone-based access channel while replacing predefined menu navigation with conversational access to services.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,VISAGENT在中国114热线的部署表明,从菜单驱动的服务访问向意图驱动的对话互动过渡。 传统的114服务要求呼叫者在与人类操作者连接之前遵循录制的提示并导航键盘菜单. VISAGENT使来电者能够直接用自然语言表达他们的请求,然后被引导到特定域的代理人进行服务执行,或者通过端到端的对话模式进行一般性询问. 这种过渡保留了基于电话的访问通道,同时将预定义的菜单导航替换为对话访问服务.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Interaction paradigms in the 114 hotline: traditional services rely on recorded prompts, keypad navigation, and human operators, whereas VISAGENT enables callers to express their needs directly and access domain agents or general conversational assistance through natural speech.
blocks.zh: 图1:114热线中的交互模式:传统服务依赖于有记录的提示,键盘导航,以及人类操作者,而VISAGENT则使呼叫者能够直接表达需求,并通过自然语音获取域名代理或一般对话援助.

blocks.en: The principal contribution of this work is an agent-centric conversational service architecture that reframes public-service hotlines from menu-driven access channels into extensible voice-agent infrastructures. By establishing a unified framework for conversational access, service discovery, agent integration, and shared user context, VISAGENT provides an architectural blueprint for integrating heterogeneous service agents into a common voice-based public-service infrastructure. The remainder of this report is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews the research relevant to the design of VISAGENT. Sections 3 and 4 present the overall architecture and its implementation, respectively. Section 5 evaluates the speech interaction and routing infrastructure. Section 6 discusses the scope, limitations, and future development of the system, and Section 7 concludes the report. Illustrative examples are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是以代理为中心的对话服务架构,将公共服务热线从菜单驱动的接入渠道调整为可扩展的语音代理基础设施。 VISAGENT通过建立一个统一的对话访问、服务发现、代理整合和共享用户环境框架,为将各种服务代理纳入共同的基于语音的公共服务基础设施提供了一个建筑蓝图。 本报告其余部分的编排如下。 第2节审查了与VISAGENT设计有关的研究。 第3节和第4节分别介绍了总体结构及其执行情况。 第5节评价语音互动和路由基础设施。 第6节讨论了该系统的范围、局限性和今后的发展,第7节结束报告。 附录A提供了示例。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 End-to-End Speech Interaction
blocks.zh: 2.1 端到端的语音互动

blocks.en: Conventional voice-based service systems typically adopt a cascaded architecture in which automatic speech recognition, language understanding, dialogue management, and text-to-speech synthesis are implemented as separate components. Although such pipelines provide modularity and facilitate component-level optimization, errors introduced at an early stage may propagate through the remaining modules, while the sequential execution of multiple components can increase response latency and disrupt conversational continuity. Recent speech-language models have sought to reduce these limitations by incorporating speech perception, language reasoning, and speech generation within more closely integrated architectures. This development has enabled spoken dialogue systems to process acoustic input directly, generate spoken responses incrementally, and preserve information that may be lost when speech is reduced to text alone.
blocks.zh: 常规语音服务系统一般采用级联结构,其中自动语音识别、语言理解、对话管理以及文本对语音合成作为单独的组成部分。 虽然此类管道提供模块化,便于组件级优化,但早期引入的错误可能会通过其余模块传播,而多个组件的相继执行则会增加响应延迟,扰乱对话的连续性. 近期的言语模式试图通过将言语感知,语言推理,和语音生成纳入更紧密的集成架构来减少这些局限性. 这一发展使得口语对话系统能够直接处理声学输入,逐渐生成口语响应,并保存在单语简化为文本时可能丢失的信息.

blocks.en: Representative systems illustrate several directions in this line of research. SpeechGPT connects a large language model with discrete speech representations to support cross-modal instruction following and spoken interaction ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Mini-Omni further investigates real-time speech generation in a compact multimodal language model ( Xie and Wu, 2024 ) , while Moshi introduces a full-duplex spoken dialogue framework capable of processing and generating speech streams concurrently ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) . MinMo extends these capabilities through a multimodal architecture designed for seamless voice interaction ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Collectively, these studies demonstrate substantial progress in speech understanding, streaming response generation, interruption handling, and conversational naturalness. Their primary emphasis, however, remains on the capabilities and evaluation of the conversational model itself. The integration of such models with large collections of independently developed service agents introduces additional architectural requirements, including intent-based dispatch, service discovery, interaction handoff, and the preservation of conversational context across system components.
blocks.zh: 代表性系统说明了这一研究的几个方向。 SpeechGPT将一个大型语言模型与离散的语音表达连接起来,支持跨模式指令跟随和语音交互(Zhang等人,2023年). 迷你号 Omni进一步在紧凑的多模式语言模型(Xie and Wu, 2024)中调查实时语音生成,而Moshi引入了能够同时处理和生成语音流的全复式语音对话框架(Défossez et al, 2024). MinMo通过为无缝语音互动设计的多式联运架构来扩展这些能力(Chen等人,2025年)。 这些研究集体表明,在语音理解、源源不断的响应生成、中断处理和对话自然性方面取得了实质性进展。 然而,它们的主要重点仍然是对话模式本身的能力和评价。 将这种模型与大量独立开发的服务代理的集合结合起来,带来了额外的建筑要求,包括基于意图的发送、服务发现、互动交接以及整个系统组成部分的对话环境的保护。

blocks.en: Neural speech synthesis constitutes another important component of voice-based interaction. Autoregressive and flow-based synthesis models have improved speech intelligibility, prosody, speaker similarity, and streaming generation. CosyVoice 2, for example, combines language-model-based semantic representation with conditional flow matching to support scalable speech synthesis and voice generation ( Du et al., 2024 ) , while HiFi-GAN provides an efficient neural vocoder for reconstructing high-fidelity waveforms from acoustic representations ( Kong et al., 2020 ) . These methods also make it possible to associate service agents with predefined or customized voices. Within VISAGENT, speech synthesis and voice cloning serve as interface technologies that allow heterogeneous agents to participate in a common spoken interaction environment.
blocks.zh: 神经语音合成是语音交互的另一个重要组成部分. 自动递归和流体合成模型提高了语音的知觉性,通畅性,扬声器相似性,流体生成性. 例如CosyVoice 2,将基于语言模型的语义表达与有条件的流匹配结合起来,支持可伸缩语音合成和语音生成(Du等人,2024年),而HiFi-GAN则提供高效的神经vocoder,用于从声表达中重建高真波形(Kong等人,2020年). 这些方法也使得有预先定义或定制声音的服务代理成为可能. 在VISAGENT内部,语音合成和语音克隆作为接口技术,使各种剂能参与共同的语音互动环境。

blocks.en: 2.2 LLM-Based Agents and Service Routing
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于LLM的代理人和服务路线

blocks.en: The emergence of large language models has substantially expanded the capabilities of intelligent agents. Earlier task-oriented agents were generally constructed around predefined rules, domain-specific policies, or fixed action spaces. LLM-based agents can instead interpret open-ended instructions, formulate intermediate decisions, invoke external tools, and adapt their behavior according to execution feedback. ReAct established an influential formulation in which language-model reasoning is interleaved with actions and observations ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . Subsequent research has examined tool learning, planning, and task decomposition as fundamental capabilities for agents operating in external environments ( Qin et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Surveys of LLM-based autonomous agents further characterize the growing range of architectures for reasoning, memory, action, and environmental interaction ( Wang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型的出现极大地扩大了智能剂的能力. 较早的面向任务的代理人一般是围绕预先确定的规则,特定领域的政策,或固定的行动空间构建的. 基于LLM的代理则可以解释开放式指令,制定中间决定,引用外部工具,并根据执行反馈调整其行为. ReAct建立了一个有影响力的提法,其中语言模型推理与行动和观察相互交织(姚等人,2022年). 随后的研究研究了工具学习,规划,任务分解作为在外部环境下作业的物剂的基本能力(秦等人,2024年;黄等人,2024年;刘等人,2024年). 对基于LLM的自主剂的调查进一步说明,推理、记忆、行动和环境互动的架构范围不断扩大(Wang等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Research on multi-agent systems extends this perspective by assigning distinct roles or capabilities to multiple agents. Frameworks such as AutoGen coordinate interactions among specialized agents through structured conversational exchanges ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . Such systems commonly focus on collaboration among agents assembled for a particular task, including planning, execution, verification, and refinement. A service platform presents a related but distinct problem. Its agents may be developed and operated by independent providers, expose heterogeneous interfaces, and offer partially overlapping capabilities. The platform must therefore determine which agent should receive a request before the selected agent begins its own task-specific reasoning and execution. Agent selection in this setting functions as a service-discovery problem rather than as an internal step of a fixed multi-agent workflow.
blocks.zh: 关于多代理系统的研究通过将不同的作用或能力赋予多个代理来扩展这一视角. AutoGen等框架通过结构化的谈话交流,协调专门人员之间的互动(Wu等人,2024年). 这种系统通常侧重于为特定任务,包括规划、执行、核查和完善而集合的代理人之间的合作。 一个服务平台是一个相关但独特的问题。 其代理人可由独立供应商开发和操作,暴露各种界面,提供部分重叠的能力。 因此,该平台必须确定在被选定的代理人开始自己的特定任务推理和执行之前,哪些代理人应当收到请求. 在此设置中的代理选择功能是一个服务发现问题,而不是固定的多代理工作流程的内部步骤.

blocks.en: 2.3 Long-Term Memory and Personalized Service Support
blocks.zh: 2.3 长期记忆和个人服务支助

blocks.en: Persistent memory has become an important research topic in language-model-based agents because a finite dialogue context cannot represent a user’s complete interaction history. Generative Agents demonstrated how stored experiences, retrieval, and reflection can support temporally coherent behavior ( Park et al., 2023 ) . MemGPT proposed a hierarchical memory-management architecture that coordinates information inside and outside the immediate context window ( Packer et al., 2023 ) . MemoryBank further investigated the retention and retrieval of long-term conversational information for personalized interaction ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) . These studies establish that agent memory involves more than retaining raw dialogue transcripts: useful memory systems must determine what information should be preserved, how it should be represented, and when it should be retrieved.
blocks.zh: 持续的内存已经成为基于语言模式的代理商中一个重要的研究课题,因为有限的对话背景不能代表用户完整的互动历史. 基因代理人演示了存储的经验、检索和反思如何支持时间上一致的行为(Park等人,2023年)。 MemGPT提出了一个分级内存管理架构,协调直接上下文窗口内外的信息(Packer等人,2023年). MemoryBank进一步调查了长期对话信息的保留和检索,用于个性化互动(Zhong等人,2024年). 这些研究确定,代理记忆不仅涉及保留原始的对话记录稿:有用的记忆系统必须确定应当保存哪些信息,如何表达信息,何时检索信息。

blocks.en: Related issues have also been studied in task-oriented dialogue. MultiWOZ provides a multi-domain benchmark for dialogue-state tracking and task completion across several service domains ( Budzianowski et al., 2018 ) , while SOLOIST investigates the construction of task-oriented dialogue systems through transfer learning and machine teaching ( Peng et al., 2021 ) . Such work has advanced the representation of user goals, dialogue context, database constraints, and task states. Most task-oriented dialogue systems, however, operate within a predefined ontology and a relatively fixed set of service backends. Their dialogue state primarily represents information required for the current task or session, whereas a service platform must additionally preserve reusable preferences across interactions and make them available to independently implemented agents. Taken together, existing studies primarily address either general-purpose long-term agent memory or dialogue state within predefined service ontologies, whereas VISAGENT employs compact user memory as shared contextual support for agent selection and subsequent task execution across heterogeneous service agents.
blocks.zh: 在面向任务的对话中也研究了相关问题。 MultiWOZ为多个服务领域的对话状态跟踪和任务完成提供了多域基准(Budzianowski等人,2018年),而SOLOIST则通过转移学习和机器教学来调查任务导向的对话系统的构建(Peng等人,2021年). 这项工作提高了用户目标、对话背景、数据库限制和任务状态的代表性。 然而,大多数面向任务的对话系统都在预先定义的本体学和相对固定的一套服务后端内运行. 它们的对话状态主要代表当前任务或会话所需的信息,而服务平台必须额外保留互动中的可重复使用偏好,并提供给独立执行的代理人。 综合起来,现有的研究主要针对的是通用长期代理内存或预先定义的服务本体学内的对话状态,而VISAGENT则使用紧凑的用户内存作为共享的背景支持,供不同服务代理人员选择和随后执行任务。

blocks.en: 3 System Overview
blocks.zh: 3 系统概览

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overall architecture of VISAGENT. The framework comprises a full-duplex user interaction layer, a two-level hierarchical routing layer, and an extensible voice-agent marketplace. The user memory service provides shared context for agent selection and task execution, while the voice-agent registration mechanism converts task agents into conversational agents and onboards them into the marketplace.
blocks.zh: 图 2:VISAGENT的整体架构. 该框架包括一个全复式用户互动层、一个两级分级路由层和一个可扩展的语音代理市场。 用户内存服务为代理选择和任务执行提供共享上下文,而语音代理注册机制则将任务代理转换成对话代理,并装入市场.

blocks.en: Figure 2 presents the overall architecture of VISAGENT. The user interaction layer provides a unified speech-to-speech interface through an end-to-end speech interaction model, supporting low-latency streaming dialogue, full-duplex communication, and user barge-in. Beneath this interface, the hierarchical routing layer separates coarse intent routing from fine-grained agent selection. A lightweight Level-1 router assigns a service request to a domain or retains it in the conversational path, after which an LLM-based Level-2 selector identifies an appropriate agent within the selected domain. The voice-agent marketplace organizes agents developed by the platform and third-party providers and exposes them to the routing layer through a common registration interface. Two supporting modules extend these core layers. The user memory service maintains explicit preferences, behavioral preferences, and recent interaction context for use by the selector and the selected agent, while the voice-agent registration mechanism supplies the descriptions, callable interfaces, and voice configuration required to convert task agents into conversational agents and incorporate them into the marketplace.
blocks.zh: 图2显示VISAGENT的总体结构。 用户互动层通过端对端语音互动模式提供统一的语音对语音接口,支持低纬度流式对话,全复式通信,用户驳入. 在这个接口下方,分级的路由层将粗细的意向路由和精细的特效选择分开. 一个轻量级-1路由器将服务请求分配到一个域或保留在对话路径中,之后一个基于LLM的Level-2选择器在选定的域内确定一个合适的代理. 语音代理市场组织平台和第三方供应商开发的代理商,并通过共同的注册界面将其暴露于路由层. 两个辅助模块扩展了这些核心层. 用户内存服务保持明确的偏好,行为偏好,以及最近的互动上下文,供选择者和被选择的代理使用,而语音代理注册机制则提供将任务代理转换成对话代理并将其纳入市场所需的描述,可调用接口,语音配置.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Request-processing workflow of VISAGENT. Spoken input is routed either to the end-to-end conversational model or to a domain-specific agent selected according to the request, dialogue context, and relevant user memory. During agent execution, failures return to the first-level router with the available context and failure feedback, while additional service requests explicitly introduced by the user are redispatched within the same session. After successful task completion, the system asks whether the user has another request. An affirmative response initiates a new request cycle, whereas a negative response triggers interaction summarization, memory update, and session termination.
blocks.zh: 图3:VISAGENT的请求处理工作流程。 语句输入要么路由到端到端的对话模式,要么按照请求,对话上下文,以及相关用户内存选择特定域代理. 在代理执行期间,失败会随着可用的上下文和失败反馈返回到一级路由器,而用户明确引入的额外服务请求则在同一会话内重新发送. 在任务成功完成后,系统询问用户是否有另一个请求. 肯定的响应启动一个新的请求周期,而否定的响应触发了交互归纳,内存更新和会话终止.

blocks.en: Figure 3 illustrates how these components participate in request processing, from spoken interaction and intent routing to agent execution and feedback.
blocks.zh: 图3说明了这些组件如何参与请求处理,从口语互动和意图路径到代理执行和反馈.

blocks.en: The speech interaction model supports direct spoken conversation, streaming responses, and full-duplex interaction with interruption handling. It also supplies intermediate transcriptions for routing and textual inputs for downstream agents. A lightweight first-level router uses the current utterance and relevant dialogue context to determine whether the request belongs to a supported service domain or should be handled by the end-to-end speech interaction model. The conversational path covers both general dialogue and requests whose service intent is not yet clear. During this path, the dialogue may continue, return to the first-level router when a service intent becomes identifiable, or terminate when no further interaction is required. When routing resumes, the accumulated dialogue context is retained so that the user does not need to restate the request. Once a service domain can be identified, the request proceeds to the second routing level. This decision requires sufficient information to identify the domain, rather than every parameter needed to complete the service.
blocks.zh: 语音交互模式支持直接的口语对话,流传的响应,以及与中断处理的全复式交互. 它还为下游代理商提供路由和文字输入的中间记录。 轻量级一级路由器使用当前语句和相关的对话上下文来确定请求是否属于一个支持的服务域,或者应当由端到端的语音交互模型处理. 对话途径既包括一般性对话,也包括服务意图尚不明确的请求。 在这个路径中,对话可以继续,当服务意图可以识别时返回一级路由器,或者在不需要进一步互动时终止. 当路由恢复时,保留累积的对话语境,这样用户就不需要重复请求. 一旦可以确定一个服务领域,请求就会进入第二个路由级别. 这一决定需要足够的信息来识别域,而不是完成服务所需的每个参数.

blocks.en: The second-level router is an LLM-based agent selector operating over the agents registered in the identified domain. It uses the current request, relevant dialogue context, retrieved user memory, and registered agent descriptions to identify a suitable service agent. Restricting selection to a domain-specific candidate set reduces the amount of agent information considered for each request and separates broad service-domain identification from fine-grained agent matching. User memory provides supplementary context for distinguishing among agents with compatible capabilities, such as preferences for particular providers or service characteristics. After selection, VISAGENT passes the request, relevant dialogue context, and retrieved memory to the selected agent for task execution.
blocks.zh: 二级路由器是一个基于LLM的代理选择器,在识别域注册的代理上运行. 它使用当前请求,相关对话框上下文,检索用户内存,以及注册代理描述来识别合适的服务代理. 将选择限制在一个特定域的候选集中,会减少为每个请求考虑的代理信息数量,并将广泛的服务域识别与精细的代理匹配区分开来. 用户内存为区分具有兼容能力的代理商提供了补充上下文,如对特定供应商的偏好或服务特征. 选择后,VISAGENT将请求,相关对话框上下文传递,并检索到内存给选定的代理执行任务.

blocks.en: The voice-agent marketplace organizes services developed by the platform or by third-party providers. Registration supplies the metadata used for discovery and routing, including domain labels, functional descriptions, and callable interfaces. Providers can also associate their agents with predefined or customized voices, allowing agents with text-based interfaces to participate in the shared spoken interaction environment.
blocks.zh: 语音代理市场安排平台或第三方供应商开发的服务。 登记提供用于发现和路由的元数据,包括域标签、功能说明和可调用的接口。 提供商还可以将自己的代理与预先定义或定制的声音联系起来,允许具有文本界面的代理参与共享的口语互动环境.

blocks.en: The memory module maintains explicit preferences, recurring behavioral preferences, and recent interaction context derived from historical interactions. For each request, relevant records are retrieved and supplied to both the second-level selector and the selected agent. These two uses operate at different levels: a preference for a particular provider may help VISAGENT distinguish among candidate agents, whereas preferences for a hotel room with breakfast or a particular train seat are applied by the selected agent during task execution. Sharing relevant memory can reduce repeated user input and support more consistent service behavior, although the resulting action depends on how each agent interprets and applies the supplied information. Interaction summaries and service outcomes provide the basis for subsequent memory updates.
blocks.zh: 内存模块保持了明确的偏好,反复出现的行为偏好,以及从历史互动中衍生出来的近期互动上下文. 对于每一项请求,都要检索有关记录,并提供给二级选择者和选定的代理人。 这两种用途在不同级别上运作:偏好特定供应商可能有助于VISAGENT区分候选代理商,而偏爱酒店房间的早餐或特定火车座椅则由选定的代理商在任务执行期间适用. 共享相关内存可以减少用户的重复输入,支持更一致的服务行为,尽管由此产生的动作取决于每个代理如何解释和应用所提供的信息. 互动摘要和服务成果为随后的内存更新提供了基础.

blocks.en: Once a service agent is selected, it manages the domain-specific workflow through the VISAGENT voice interface. The agent may collect missing information, confirm task parameters, invoke its internal tools or external services, and return the execution result. Business-specific details that are not required for first-level routing, such as a travel date, passenger information, or hotel preferences, are therefore collected during agent execution rather than by the router. During this interaction, the agent may report successful completion, execution failure, or the detection of an additional service request that falls outside its own capabilities. In the case of failure, the available dialogue context and failure feedback are returned to the first-level router. If the user introduces an additional service request, the new request and the accumulated context are likewise returned to the router for a new routing decision within the same session. After successful execution, the result is presented to the user and the system asks whether any further request remains.
blocks.zh: 一旦选定一个服务代理,它通过VISAGENT语音接口管理特定域的工作流程. 代理人可能收集缺失的信息,确认任务参数,引用其内部工具或外部服务,并返回执行结果. 因此,在代理执行期间而不是由路由器收集第一级路线不需要的具体业务细节,如旅行日期,乘客信息,或酒店偏好等. 在这一互动过程中,代理人可以报告成功完成,执行失败,或者发现超出自身能力的额外服务请求. 出现故障时,将可用的对话框上下文和故障反馈返回一级路由器. 如果用户引入额外服务请求,新请求和累积上下文同样会返回路由器,在同一会话内作出新的路由决定. 在成功执行之后,结果将提交给用户,系统询问是否还有任何其他要求。

blocks.en: When the conversational path terminates or the user confirms that no additional request remains after task completion, VISAGENT summarizes the interaction, records the service outcome, and updates the corresponding memory entries. Explicitly stated preferences, recurring behavioral patterns, and recent task context can therefore be incorporated into later interactions. The updated memory becomes available to subsequent routing and service execution, completing the interaction loop between speech input, routing, agent execution, feedback, and long-term personalization.
blocks.zh: 当对话路径终止或用户确认任务完成后不再有额外请求时,VISAGENT对交互进行总结,记录服务结果,并更新相应的内存条目. 因此,可以将明确表达的偏好,反复出现的行为模式,以及最近的任务背景纳入以后的互动中. 更新后的内存可用于后续的路由和服务执行,完成语音输入,路由,代理执行,反馈,以及长期个性化之间的交互循环.

blocks.en: 4 System Components
blocks.zh: 4 系统组件

blocks.en: 4.1 End-to-End Speech Interaction Model
blocks.zh: 4.1 终到终语音互动模型

blocks.en: The speech interaction component provides the common voice interface through which users access both general conversation and domain-specific services. As shown in Figure 4 , it consists of an audio encoder, an input adapter, an LLM, a streaming audio decoder, and a vocoder. The audio encoder extracts acoustic representations from incoming speech, and the adapter maps them into the representation space consumed by the LLM. The hidden representations generated by the LLM condition the streaming audio decoder, which produces discrete acoustic features incrementally. The vocoder subsequently reconstructs these features as an output waveform.
blocks.zh: 语音交互部分提供共同的语音界面,用户通过该界面获取一般对话以及特定域的服务. 如图4所示,它包括一个音频编码器,一个输入适配器,一个LLM,一个流音解码器,以及一个vocoder. 音频编码器从即将到来的语音中提取声波表示,适配器将其映射到LLM消耗的表达空间中. LLM 生成的隐藏表达条件 流体音频解码器,它渐进生成离散的声学特征. vocoder后来将这些特征重建为输出波形.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Architecture of the speech interaction component used in VISAGENT. The primary speech-to-speech path integrates an audio encoder, an input adapter, an LLM, a streaming audio decoder, and a vocoder. An auxiliary CTC transcription branch supplies textual representations to the hierarchical routing layer and downstream service agents.
blocks.zh: 图4:VISAGENT中使用的语音互动组件的结构. 主语音对语音路径集成一个音频编码器,一个输入适配器,一个LLM,一个流音解码器,以及一个vocoder. 一个辅助CTC转录分支向分级路由层和下游服务代理提供文字表述.

blocks.en: In parallel with the speech-to-speech path, an auxiliary connectionist temporal classification (CTC) decoder generates intermediate transcriptions from the encoded speech representations. These transcriptions provide textual inputs for both hierarchical routing and downstream agent interaction. The routing layer uses the transcribed request together with the available dialogue context to determine an appropriate processing path, while a selected service agent receives the corresponding text and context for task-oriented interaction. VISAGENT therefore employs direct speech-to-speech generation at the user-facing interface while exposing a textual integration interface to independently implemented routing and agent components.
blocks.zh: 与语音对语音路径平行的是辅助连接器时间分类(CTC)解码器生成编码语音表达的中间转录. 这些转录为分级路由和下游代理交互提供了文字投入. 路由层使用转录请求与可用对话框上下文来确定适当的处理路径,而一个选定的服务代理则接收相应的文字和上下文,用于面向任务的互动. VISAGENT因此在用户界面直接使用语音对语音生成,同时将文本集成界面暴露于独立执行的路由和代理组件.

blocks.en: The three-phase training procedure is illustrated in Figure 5 . In the first phase, the input adapter is optimized while the remaining model components are frozen, aligning the acoustic representations produced by the audio encoder with the LLM input space. In the second phase, the audio decoder is trained while the audio encoder, input adapter, and LLM remain frozen. This phase maps the hidden representations of the LLM to discrete acoustic features and incorporates streaming generation into decoder training. In the final phase, the input adapter, LLM, and audio decoder are jointly fine-tuned while the audio encoder remains frozen, allowing the speech input, language processing, and speech output components to be adapted jointly. The training corpus comprises approximately 64,000 hours of open-source Mandarin speech, 10,000 hours of open-source English speech, and 1,000 hours of private Chinese speech.
blocks.zh: 图5说明了三阶段培训程序。 在第一阶段,输入适配器在剩余模型组件被冷冻的同时得到优化,将音频编码器产生的音效表示器与LLM输入空间对齐. 在第二阶段,音频解码器在音频解码器,输入适配器和LLM保持冷冻的同时接受训练. 这个阶段将LLM的隐藏表示图映射到离散的声学特征上,并将流源生成法纳入解码器训练中. 在最后阶段,输入适配器LLM和音频解码器在音频编码器保持冷冻的同时进行联合微调,使语音输入,语言处理,语音输出组件得以联合调整. 培训大纲包括近64 000小时的开源普通话、10 000小时的开源英语和1000小时的私人汉语。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Three-phase training procedure for the speech interaction model. Stage 1 trains the input adapter to align the output of the frozen audio encoder with the representation space of the frozen LLM. Stage 2 trains the audio decoder to generate discrete acoustic features from the frozen LLM representations. Stage 3 jointly fine-tunes the input adapter, LLM, and audio decoder while keeping the audio encoder frozen. Snowflake and flame symbols denote frozen and trainable neural modules, respectively; the vocoder converts the decoder output into the final speech waveform.
blocks.zh: 图5:语音互动模式的三阶段培训程序。 第1阶段训练输入适配器,使冷冻音频编码器的输出与冷冻LLM的表示空间一致. 第2阶段训练音频解码器,从冷冻的LLM表示中产生离散的声学特征. 第3阶段联合微调输入适配器,LLM,音频解码器,同时保持音频编码器的冻结. 雪花和火焰符号分别表示冷冻和可训练的神经模块;vocoder将解码器输出转换为最后的语音波形.

blocks.en: The implementation processes incoming speech concurrently with response generation and employs endpoint echo cancellation to support full-duplex interaction and user interruption. Users can therefore supplement, correct, or redirect an utterance while a response is being generated. Voice activity detection (VAD) identifies utterance boundaries before the resulting transcription and dialogue context are passed to the routing layer. Section 5.2 reports the observed interaction latency, including the VAD interval, separately from model-level latency estimates.
blocks.zh: 执行过程与响应生成同时处理即将到来的语音,并使用端点回声取消,以支持全复式互动和用户中断. 因此,在生成答复时,用户可以补充、纠正或重定向一个言论。 语音活动检测(VAD)在生成的转录和对话背景传递到路由层之前,先识别语音边界. 第5.2节报告观察到的相互作用延迟,包括VAD间隔,与模型级延迟估计分开。

blocks.en: 4.2 Two-Level Agent Routing
blocks.zh: 4.2 两级特工巡逻

blocks.en: The hierarchical routing layer implements coarse-to-fine request dispatch over the voice-agent marketplace. Directly comparing every request with all registered agents would cause the selector’s input context and inference cost to grow with the size of the marketplace. VISAGENT therefore separates routing into two decisions: a lightweight first-level router determines whether the request should remain on the conversational path or enter a supported service domain, and an LLM-based second-level selector identifies a suitable agent only among the candidates registered in that domain. This separation reduces the candidate space presented to the LLM while distinguishing domain identification from fine-grained agent matching.
blocks.zh: 分级的路由层通过语音代理市场执行粗细到精细的请求发送. 直接将每项请求与所有注册代理人进行比较,将使选择者的投入背景和推断成本随着市场规模的增加而增加。 VISAGENT因此将路由分离成两个决定:一个轻量级一级路由器决定请求是应该留在对话路径上,还是进入一个支持的服务域,一个基于LLM的二级选择器仅在该域注册的候选人中确定一个合适的代理. 这种分离减少了提交LLM的候选空间,同时区分了域名识别与细纹代理匹配.

blocks.en: The first-level router receives the transcribed utterance together with the available dialogue context and determines whether the request should be handled by the end-to-end speech interaction model or dispatched to a supported service domain. The current implementation uses a BERT-based intent classifier ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) . Everyday conversation, general question answering, and other requests that do not require an external service agent remain with the speech interaction model, whereas service-oriented requests are assigned to the corresponding domain. If the service intent is not yet sufficiently clear for domain classification, the speech interaction model continues the dialogue and the request is evaluated again after clarification. The first-level router only determines the processing path and service domain; collection of task-specific parameters remains within the selected agent’s workflow.
blocks.zh: 一级路由器与可用的对话上下文一起接收转录语句,并确定请求是应该通过端到端的语音交互模型处理,还是发送到一个支持的服务域. 目前的实施使用基于BERT的意向分类器(Devlin等人,2019年). 每天的谈话,一般的问答,以及不需要外部服务代理的其他请求,都保留在语音互动模式中,而面向服务的请求则被分配到相应的领域. 如果服务意图尚不足以明确域分类,语音交互模式继续对话,并在澄清后再次评价请求. 一级路由器只决定处理路径和服务域;任务特定参数的收集仍然属于选定的代理工作流程.

blocks.en: Once a service domain has been identified, VISAGENT retrieves the descriptions of agents registered in that domain and the user-memory entries relevant to agent selection. The selection prompt combines the current request, pertinent dialogue context, domain-specific agent descriptions, capability and coverage constraints, and applicable user preferences. The LLM-based selector then identifies an agent whose registered capabilities satisfy the current request. User memory serves as supplementary selection context and does not override an explicit current requirement or compensate for an agent whose capabilities are incompatible with the requested service.
blocks.zh: 一旦确定了一个服务域,VISAGENT就检索了在该域注册的代理的描述以及与代理选择有关的用户-记忆条目. 选择提示将当前请求,相关对话上下文,特定域代理描述,能力和覆盖限制,以及适用的用户偏好结合起来. 以LLM为基础的选择器然后确定一个其注册能力满足当前请求的代理. 用户内存作为补充选择上下文,不会凌驾于明确的当前要求之上,也不会补偿其能力与所请求的服务不相容的代理.

blocks.en: 4.3 Voice Agent Marketplace and Registration
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 语音代理

blocks.en: The voice-agent marketplace maintains a catalog of service agents organized by domain. Agents may be operated by the VISAGENT platform or by third-party providers, and multiple agents may offer overlapping services while differing in provider, geographic coverage, supported operations, and other service characteristics. The marketplace exposes their registered metadata to the routing layer without requiring access to their internal business logic, thereby separating platform-level service discovery from provider-specific task execution.
blocks.zh: 语音代理市场设有按域排列的服务代理目录. 代理商可以由VISAGENT平台或第三方提供商运营,多个代理商可能提供重叠服务,同时在提供商,地域覆盖,支持业务以及其他服务特征上有所不同. 市场将其注册的元数据暴露在路由层上,而不需要访问其内部业务逻辑,从而将平台级服务发现与供应商特定任务执行分离.

blocks.en: Each registration record specifies the agent’s identity and provider, service domain, natural-language description, capabilities, service tags, coverage regions, endpoint, and function specifications. The endpoint identifies the URL used to invoke a remotely hosted agent. Each function specification describes a callable operation and its corresponding input and output parameters. Together, these fields support marketplace organization, agent discovery, fine-grained selection, and service invocation. Before an agent is indexed in the marketplace, the VISAGENT platform subjects it to security review and operational testing. Only agents that pass these checks become discoverable by the routing layer and eligible for invocation. Table 1 summarizes the roles of the registration fields.
blocks.zh: 每一份注册记录都列明代理人的身份和提供者、服务领域、自然语言描述、能力、服务标记、覆盖区域、终点和功能规格。 端点识别用于引用远程主机代理的 URL 。 每个函数规格描述一个可调用操作及其相应的输入和输出参数. 这些领域共同支持市场组织、代理人发现、精细挑选和服务引用。 在一个代理商在市场指数化之前,VISAGENT平台对其进行安全审查和操作测试. 只有通过这些检查的特工才能被路由层发现,并有资格援引. 表1概述了登记领域的作用。

blocks.en: Table 1: Information supplied during agent registration. Appendix A.1 gives a compact example.
blocks.zh: 表1:在代理登记期间提供的资料。 附录A.1提供了一个紧凑的例子。

blocks.en: Once registration is complete, the agent is indexed under its designated service domain and becomes available to the hierarchical routing layer. The domain label determines the candidate group exposed to the second-level selector, while the functional description, capabilities, coverage information, and interface specification support fine-grained matching. After an agent is selected, VISAGENT invokes the registered endpoint and passes the request and relevant interaction context to the provider’s implementation. The provider remains responsible for its internal task logic, external resources, and execution reliability.
blocks.zh: 注册完成后,代理人在其指定服务领域下进行索引,并可供分级路由层使用. 域名标签决定了接触二级选择器的候选组,而功能描述,能力,覆盖信息和界面规格则支持精细的匹配. 在选定代理人后,VISAGENT引用已登记的终点,并将请求和相关互动上下文传递给提供者的执行。 提供者仍对其内部任务逻辑、外部资源和执行可靠性负责。

blocks.en: During registration, a provider can associate an agent with either a preset synthesis voice or a customized voice generated from a short reference recording. The current implementation provides more than 40 preset voice styles, along with speech synthesis and voice cloning services. A text-based agent can therefore receive transcribed user input and return textual responses, which VISAGENT renders through the configured voice without requiring the provider to implement a separate speech interface.
blocks.zh: 在注册期间,提供商可以将代理与预设的合成语音或从简短的参考记录中生成的定制语音联系起来. 目前的实施提供了40多种预设语音风格,以及语音合成和语音克隆服务. 因此,基于文本的代理可以接收转写用户输入和返回文本回复,VISAGENT通过配置的语音做出这些回复,而不需要提供者实施单独的语音界面.

blocks.en: Voice profiles can be selected according to an agent’s role and service context. For example, a legal-consultation agent may use a formal and serious voice, whereas an agent providing psychological counseling or emotional support may adopt a calm, gentle, and reassuring voice. Associating a stable voice profile with each agent helps users distinguish among services, improves the contextual appropriateness of spoken responses, and gives heterogeneous agents recognizable and consistent identities within the shared voice interface.
blocks.zh: 语音简介可以根据代理角色和服务背景选择。 例如,法律咨询代理人可以使用正式和严肃的声音,而提供心理咨询或情感支持的代理人可以采用冷静、温和和令人放心的声音。 将稳定的语音简介与每个代理连接起来,有助于用户区分各种服务,改善口语响应的背景适当性,并在共享语音界面中提供可识别和一致的不同代理。

blocks.en: 4.4 User Memory Support
blocks.zh: 4.4 用户内存支持

blocks.en: The user memory service maintains compact user information that can be reused across service interactions. It provides relevant preferences and recent task context to the routing layer and selected service agents, reducing the need to repeatedly process or request information from earlier interactions. The module is responsible for memory construction, retrieval, and delivery, while the selected agent remains responsible for interpreting the supplied information within its own task workflow.
blocks.zh: 用户内存服务维持可跨服务互动重复使用的紧凑用户信息. 它为路由层和选定的服务代理商提供了相关的偏好和近期的任务背景,减少了反复处理或要求早期互动信息的需求. 该模块负责内存的构建、检索和交付,而选定的代理仍然负责在自己的任务工作流程中解释所提供的信息。

blocks.en: VISAGENT organizes user memory into three complementary types. Explicit preference memory records preferences that users state as generally applicable, such as a preferred service provider. Behavioral preference memory captures recurring choices inferred from multiple interactions. Context memory retains recent or task-specific information, such as an active booking, a current travel plan, or the parameters of a recent service request. This separation prevents persistent preferences, recurring behavioral patterns, and temporary task context from being treated as equivalent information.
blocks.zh: VISAGENT将用户内存组织为三种互补类型. 明确偏好内存记录用户声明为普遍适用的偏好,如偏好服务提供者. 行为偏好内存捕捉从多种相互作用中推断出来的反复出现的选择. 上下文内存保留了最近或特定任务的信息,如主动预订,当前旅行计划,或最近服务请求的参数. 这种分离使得持续的偏好,反复出现的行为模式,以及临时的任务上下文都无法被当作等效的信息.

blocks.en: After an interaction is completed, VISAGENT constructs a compact execution summary containing the service domain, selected agent, task, invoked services, request constraints, execution details, and outcome. The summary provides the basis for updating the corresponding memory records without retaining the complete dialogue transcript as long-term memory. Appendix A.2 illustrates these distinctions using a hotel-service example.
blocks.zh: 在互动完成后,VISAGENT构建了包含服务域,选定代理,任务,引用服务,请求约束,执行细节和结果的紧凑执行摘要. 摘要为更新相应的内存记录提供了基础,而不保留完整的对话记录作为长期记忆. 附录A.2以旅馆服务为例说明了这些区别。

blocks.en: After the first-level router identifies a service domain, the memory service retrieves records relevant to the current domain and request. Structured retrieval is used for explicit and behavioral preferences, while semantic retrieval identifies related information from recent context. For each request, the memory service retrieves only the preferences, agent-use history, and recent task context relevant to the identified domain and current user need. The second-level selector and the selected agent therefore receive a compact, task-relevant memory subset rather than the user’s complete interaction history.
blocks.zh: 在一级路由器识别一个服务域后,内存服务会检索与当前域和请求相关的记录. 结构化检索用于明示和行为偏好,而语义检索则从最近上下文中识别相关信息. 对于每个请求,内存服务只检索首选,代理使用历史,以及与已识别域和当前用户需求相关的近期任务背景. 因此,二级选择器和选定的代理器会收到一个紧凑、与任务相关的内存子集,而不是用户的完整互动历史。

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: This section evaluates the principal components of VISAGENT, including speech interaction performance, interaction latency, speech synthesis quality, and the accuracy and scalability of hierarchical agent routing.
blocks.zh: 本节评价了VISAGENT的主要组成部分,包括语音交互性能,交互延时性,语音合成质量,以及分级代理路由的准确性和可伸缩性.

blocks.en: 5.1 Speech Interaction Performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 语音互动性能

blocks.en: We evaluate the speech interaction model on spoken dialogue tasks that assess speech understanding, reasoning, and oral response generation, and compare its performance with representative speech-enabled models. The evaluation uses URO-Bench, a speech-to-speech benchmark organized into basic and pro tracks, each containing 20 test sets at different levels of difficulty ( Yan et al., 2025 ) . We report results on 16 open-source Chinese test sets, including nine from the basic track and seven from the pro track. Table 2 compares the 14B speech interaction model used in VISAGENT with MiMo-Audio, Step-Audio-mini, and Qwen3-Omni ( Team et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于口头对话任务的语音互动模式,该模式评估语音理解、推理和口头反应生成,并将其表现与有代表性的语音辅助模式进行比较。 评估使用URO-Bench,一个语音对语音的基准,被组织成基础轨道和亲轨轨道,每个轨道包含20套不同难度的测试集(Yan等人,2025年). 我们报告16套中国开源测试结果,其中9套来自基础赛道,7套来自正赛道. 表2比较了VISAGENT中使用的14B语音互动模型与MiMo-Audio,Step-Audio-mini,以及Qune3-Omni(Team等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年;徐等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Table 2: Results on 16 open-source Chinese test sets from URO-Bench. The subset averages are computed over the displayed test sets in each track. “VISAGENT speech” denotes the speech interaction model used in VISAGENT. Boldface marks the highest subset average in each track.
blocks.zh: 表2:16个公开来源的结果 中国测试集从URO-Bench. 子集平均值通过每个音轨中显示的测试集计算. “VISAGENT语音”是指VISAGENT中使用的语音交互模式。 粗体表示每个音轨中最高的子集平均值.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , the VISAGENT speech interaction model achieves subset averages of 71.547 and 66.510 on the basic and pro tracks, respectively, exceeding the strongest comparison result in each subset by 0.601 and 6.379 points. Across the 16 individual test sets, it achieves first place on 4 datasets and second place on 8 datasets, underscoring its superior capabilities in advanced reasoning, safety, and open-domain conversational response generation. These results indicate that the VISAGENT speech interaction model remains strong and balanced performance across diverse spoken dialogue tasks.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,VISAGENT语音交互模型在基本轨道和亲轨轨道上分别实现71.547和66.510的子集平均值,超过每个子集最强的比较结果0.601和6.379点. 在整个16个单个测试集中,它在4个数据集上取得了第一位,在8个数据集上取得了第二位,强调了其在高级推理,安全,以及开放域对话响应生成方面的优越能力. 这些结果表明,VISAGENT的语音互动模式在各种口语对话任务中仍然保持强劲和平衡的表现。

blocks.en: 5.2 Full-Duplex Interaction Latency
blocks.zh: 5.2 完全双倍相互作用

blocks.en: Full-duplex interaction latency is evaluated at both the theoretical and application levels. Table 3 reports theoretical latency estimates and the practical latency measured during system operation. The actual system delays are averaged over approximately 40 interaction rounds. VISAGENT achieves an average end-to-end latency of 1.05 seconds, which includes the 800 ms endpoint-detection interval used by the voice activity detection module.
blocks.zh: 在理论和应用两个层面都对全复式互动延时性进行评价。 表3报告了在系统运作期间测得的理论延迟估计和实际延迟。 实际系统延误平均约为40个互动回合。 VISAGENT实现平均端到端间距为1.05秒,其中包括语音活动检测模块使用的800ms端点检测间隔.

blocks.en: Table 3: Theoretical latency and practical latency. Application-level measurements were collected on February 12, 2026.
blocks.zh: 表3:理论延迟和实际延迟. 2026年2月12日采集了应用级测量数据.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , the theoretical latency of VISAGENT speech model is 300 ms, which is slightly higher than LLaMA-Omni (226 ms) and Moshi (200 ms), but substantially lower than MinMo (600 ms). In practice, however, VISAGENT achieved the lowest actual interaction latency among all tested systems, including several industry-level applications. For these deployed systems, where model architectures are undisclosed, latency was estimated from recorded interaction sessions by calculating average delays.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,VISAGENT语音模型的理论延迟是300ms,略高于LLaMA-Omni(226ms)和Moshi(200ms),但大大低于MinMo(600ms). 然而,实际上,VISAGENT在所有经过测试的系统之间实现了最低的实际互动延缓,包括若干行业一级的应用。 对于这些已部署的系统,在模型架构未披露的情况下,通过计算平均延迟,从记录的互动会话中估计了延迟性。

blocks.en: 5.3 Speech Synthesis Quality
blocks.zh: 5.3 语音综合质量

blocks.en: Speech synthesis quality is evaluated on SEEDTTS test-zh by comparing the VISAGENT synthesis component with GPT-SoVITS, F5-TTS, fish-speech, and CosyVoice 2 ( RVC-Boss, 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Liao et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ) . Table 4 reports Chinese character error rate (CER) for content consistency, computed with a shared ASR backend, and Normalized Mean Opinion Score (NMOS) for perceived speech quality.
blocks.zh: 通过将VISAGENT合成成分与GPT-SoVITS、F5-TTS、鱼语和CosyVoice 2(RVC-Bos,2023年;Chen等人,2024年;Liao等人,2024年;Du等人,2024年)比较,对SEEDTS测试-zh的语音合成质量进行评估。 表4 报告 内容一致性的中文字符错误率(CER),用共享的ASR后端计算,而感知的语音质量的规范化平均值分数(NMOS).

blocks.en: Table 4: Speech synthesis results on SEEDTTS test-zh. Lower CER and higher NMOS indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 表4:SEEDTS测试zh的语音合成结果. 低CER和高NMOS显示性能较好.

blocks.en: The VISAGENT synthesis component obtains a CER of 1.360 and an NMOS of 3.491, ranking second on both metrics among the systems in Table 4 . Its CER is close to the 1.340 obtained by fish-speech, while its NMOS is close to the 3.500 obtained by CosyVoice 2. These results demonstrate competitive content consistency and perceived speech quality on the Chinese test set.
blocks.zh: VISAGENT合成部分获得的CER为1.360,NMOS为3.491,在表4所列系统中,在两个指标中排名第二。 其CER接近于鱼语获得的1.340,而NMOS接近于CosyVoice 2获得的3.500. 这些结果显示了中文测试集内容的竞争性一致性和感知的语音质量.

blocks.en: 5.4 Routing Accuracy and Scalability
blocks.zh: 5.4 精确度和可扩展性

blocks.en: The routing evaluation uses 100 user queries and marketplace sizes of 50, 100, and 319 agents. The largest marketplace spans 15 domains, including shopping, education, psychology, law, home services, medicine, travel, government affairs, finance, culture, pets, dining, tourism, sports, and other services. Each agent is represented by a concise functional description. The single-level baseline supplies the complete uncategorized agent pool to an LLM. The two-level configuration first uses a lightweight classifier to identify the service domain and then supplies only the agents in that domain to an LLM-based selector. DeepSeek V3, Qwen3, and Kimi K2 are evaluated as selectors under both routing configurations.
blocks.zh: 路线评价采用100个用户查询和50、100和319代理商的市场规模。 最大的市场跨越15个领域,包括购物、教育、心理学、法律、家庭服务、医药、旅行、政府事务、金融、文化、宠物、餐饮、旅游、体育和其他服务。 每个代理人都以简明的功能描述为代表. 单级基线向LLM提供完整的未分类剂池. 两级配置首先使用轻量级分类器来识别服务域,然后只向基于LLM的选择器提供该域中的代理. DeepSeek V3,Qwen3和Kimi K2在两种路由配置下被评价为选择者.

blocks.en: Table 5: Routing accuracy and latency on 100 user queries under three marketplace sizes.
blocks.zh: 表5:在三个市场范围内对100个用户查询的准确性和耐久性。

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that all configurations achieve 100% accuracy with latency below one second when the marketplace contains 50 agents. When the marketplace grows to 319 agents, single-level routing requires 8–10 seconds and achieves 98–99% accuracy. In comparison, the two-level configuration maintains latency below one second and achieves 100% accuracy on the evaluated query set. These results highlight the scalability and efficiency advantages of the hierarchical routing architecture for agent selection in an expanding marketplace.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,当市场含有50种制剂时,所有配置都达到100%的准确度,但低于1秒。 当市场增长到319个代理时,单层路由需要8–10秒,并达到98–99%的精度. 相比之下,双层配置保持1秒以下的耐久性,在评价的查询集上实现100%的准确性. 这些结果突出表明,在不断扩大的市场上选择代理商的分级路径结构具有可扩展性和效率优势。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion, Limitations, and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6 讨论、限制和未来工作

blocks.en: VISAGENT provides an integrated system framework for connecting users with heterogeneous service agents through a unified voice interface. It centralizes voice interaction, service discovery, routing, and memory delivery while leaving business execution with the selected provider. This separation supports extensibility, but the platform’s ability to identify a suitable agent does not guarantee that the agent can complete every request. Completion also depends on available resources, tool behavior, service policies, and the agent’s handling of dialogue and user context. An execution failure may return to routing, but redispatch cannot by itself remove a business constraint such as unavailable inventory.
blocks.zh: VISAGENT提供一个综合系统框架,通过统一的语音接口将用户与多种服务代理连接起来。 它集中了语音交互,服务发现,路由,和内存发送,同时将业务执行留给选定的提供者. 这种分离支持扩展性,但平台识别合适代理的能力并不能保证代理能够完成每一个请求. 完成还取决于现有资源、工具行为、服务政策以及代理人对对话和用户背景的处理。 执行失败可能回到路由,但重新发送本身无法消除诸如不可用库存等业务限制。

blocks.en: The routing evaluation is based on 100 user queries and marketplace configurations containing up to 319 agents, which limits the assessment of routing performance at larger scales. Future evaluations will expand both the query set and the agent pool as the marketplace grows. Practical latency is measured at the system level using commercial systems whose underlying hardware configurations cannot be controlled or standardized. The resulting measurements therefore characterize the end-to-end latency of the evaluated systems under the test conditions rather than the intrinsic latency of their speech models. The memory service has not yet been evaluated because the available interaction data remain limited. Its observed effectiveness also depends on how individual agents interpret and apply the retrieved user context, making it difficult to isolate the contribution of the memory service from downstream agent behavior. Future evaluation will therefore assess memory retrieval and memory-assisted agent selection separately from preference application and task execution, with standardized agent implementations used to control agent-specific variation.
blocks.zh: 路由评价以100个用户查询和市场配置为基础,包含多达319个代理商,限制了对路由性能大尺度的评估. 随着市场的增长,今后的评价将扩大查询集和代理库。 实际延迟性在系统层面使用其基础硬件配置无法控制或标准化的商业系统进行测量. 因此,所得出的衡量标准是受评价系统在测试条件下的端到端间歇性,而不是其语音模型的内在间歇性。 由于现有互动数据仍然有限,故尚未评价内存服务. 其观测到的有效性还取决于单个代理如何解释和应用被检索的用户上下文,因此很难将内存服务的贡献从下游代理行为中分离出来. 因此,未来的评价将评估内存检索和内存辅助代理的选择与优先应用和任务执行分开,标准化代理执行用于控制特定代理的变异.

blocks.en: Future work will extend VISAGENT in two directions: cross-service continuation and adaptive replanning. Cross-service continuation will enable the framework to identify relationships between successive service goals, preserve task-relevant context across agent boundaries, and dispatch follow-up requests without requiring users to repeat information that has already been collected. This capability is particularly relevant to compound service scenarios, such as requesting hotel accommodation after completing a flight reservation. Adaptive replanning will allow the framework to revise an ongoing service plan when execution fails, resource conditions change, or the user modifies the original requirements. The system could then identify feasible alternatives, reconstruct the required sequence of agent calls, and obtain user confirmation before continuing execution. Future research will investigate the context-transfer mechanisms, plan-validation methods, and recovery policies required to implement and evaluate these capabilities reliably.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将把VISAGENT扩展到两个方向:跨服务持续和适应性再规划。 跨服务的持续将使框架能够确定连续服务目标之间的关系,在代理边界内保持与任务相关的背景,并发出后续请求,而无需用户重复已经收集的信息。 这一能力与复合服务情况特别相关,例如,在完成预定飞行后请求旅馆住宿。 适应性的重新规划将使框架能够在执行失败、资源条件发生变化或用户修改原要求时修订现行服务计划。 该系统然后可以确定可行的替代办法,重建所需的代理通话顺序,并在继续执行之前获得用户确认。 未来的研究将调查可靠地实施和评价这些能力所需的上下文转移机制、计划验证方法和恢复政策。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented VISAGENT, an integrated system framework for voice-based access to heterogeneous service agents. VISAGENT combines end-to-end speech interaction, hierarchical agent routing, voice-agent registration, an extensible agent marketplace, and user memory support within a unified architecture. Its two-level routing design separates efficient domain identification from fine-grained agent selection, while the registration mechanism provides a standardized means of incorporating third-party task agents into the voice service ecosystem. User memory further supplies task-relevant context to both agent selection and service execution. This organization separates reusable platform capabilities from provider-specific business logic and supports the continued expansion of voice-based services.
blocks.zh: 该文件介绍了VISAGENT,这是一个以语音方式接触各种服务代理人的综合系统框架。 VISAGENT结合了端对端语音交互,分级代理路由,语音代理注册,可扩展代理市场,以及统一架构内的用户内存支持. 其两级路由设计将高效域识别与精细纹饰代理选择区分开来,而注册机制则提供了将第三方任务代理纳入语音服务生态系统的标准化手段. 用户内存进一步为代理选择和服务执行提供与任务相关的上下文. 这个组织将可重复使用的平台能力与提供商特有的业务逻辑区分开来,并支持语音服务的持续扩展.

blocks.en: The experimental results demonstrate competitive performance in spoken dialogue and speech synthesis, low-latency full-duplex interaction, and the scalability and efficiency advantages of hierarchical routing across the evaluated marketplace configurations. The deployment of VISAGENT in China’s 114 hotline further demonstrates the feasibility of the framework in a real-world public-service environment. These results establish VISAGENT as a practical architectural foundation for building extensible voice-agent service systems.
blocks.zh: 实验结果表明口语对话和语音合成方面的竞争表现,低纬度的全复式互动,以及经过评价的市场配置的分级路径的可扩展性和效率优势。 VISAGENT在中国114热线的部署进一步证明了该框架在现实世界公共服务环境中的可行性。 这些成果将VISAGENT作为建设可扩展语音代理服务系统的实际建筑基础。

blocks.en: A.2 User Memory Example
blocks.zh: A.2 用户记忆示例

blocks.en: The hotel example illustrates how a historical interaction is converted into a compact execution summary and subsequently contributes to structured user memory. The interaction begins with a request for a one-night stay in Suzhou on October 4. The user then provides a budget, room preference, breakfast requirement, and preferred location before selecting one of the options returned by the agent.
blocks.zh: 酒店的例子说明历史互动如何转化为紧凑的执行摘要,随后有助于结构化的用户记忆. 互动开始于10月4日要求在苏州过夜. 用户随后提供预算,房间偏好,早餐要求,以及首选地点,然后选择代理商返回的选项之一.

This example distinguishes recurring accommodation patterns from the details of a recent booking. Behavioral memory records patterns aggregated across interactions, including an agent that has been used repeatedly, whereas context memory retains the agent, parameters, and outcome associated with the recent accommodation task. During a later hotel request, VISAGENT can supply the relevant agent-use history and provider information to the selector and pass execution-related preferences and context to the selected hotel agent.
blocks.zh: 这个例子区分了经常性住宿模式和最近预订的细节。 行为记忆记录模式在各种相互作用中汇总在一起,包括一个被反复使用的代理,而上下文内存则保留了与最近住宿任务相关的代理、参数和结果。 在后来的酒店请求中,VISAGENT可以向选择者提供有关代理使用历史和提供者的信息,并将与执行有关的偏好和上下文传递给选定的酒店代理.

blocks.en: A.3 Request Routing and Agent Interaction
blocks.zh: A.3 请求路线和代理互动

blocks.en: Figure 6 illustrates an agent-mediated flight-booking interaction. The user requests an outbound flight from Beijing to Shanghai at 8 a.m. the following day and a return flight at 4 p.m. The first routing level identifies the flight domain, and the second-level selector chooses an appropriate flight agent. The selected agent then collects the required passenger information and invokes its search and booking functions to complete the request.
blocks.zh: 图6显示了由代理人代理的航班预订互动。 用户要求次日早上8时从北京飞往上海的航班,下午4时回程. 第一级航线确定飞行领域,二级选手选择合适的飞行代理. 选定代理人随后收集所需的乘客信息,并援引其搜索和预订功能完成请求.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Illustrative flight-booking interaction in VISAGENT. The hierarchical routing process identifies the flight domain and selects a flight agent. The selected agent plans the task, collects missing passenger information through spoken interaction, and invokes flight-search and booking functions to complete the outbound and return reservations.
blocks.zh: 图6:VISAGENT中模拟飞行记录互动。 分级的路由过程可以识别飞行域并选择飞行代理. 被选中的代理人计划任务,通过口语互动收集缺失的乘客信息,并援引飞行搜索和预订功能来完成出入境和返回预订.

blocks.en: The example illustrates the division of responsibility between the VISAGENT framework and the selected service agent. VISAGENT performs domain classification and agent selection before transferring the request and available context to the flight agent. The agent determines which task parameters are missing, obtains the necessary information through dialogue, and invokes the registered functions required for execution. Because both flight directions are specified in the initial request and handled by the same agent, the interaction constitutes a single domain-specific service task.
blocks.zh: 该实例说明了VISAGENT框架与选定的服务代理机构之间的责任分工。 VISAGENT在将请求和可用上下文转移给飞行代理之前进行域分类和代理选择. 代理确定缺少哪些任务参数,通过对话获取必要的信息,并引用执行所需的注册函数. 由于两个飞行方向在初始请求中都有指定,并由同一代理处理,所以交互构成单一域特定服务任务.
